name: Pacific Image Electronics Co., Ltd.
summary: Pacific Image Electronics Co., Ltd. provides advanced scanning and imaging technologies to customers both within Taiwan and globally. The company's product portfolio encompasses high-fidelity film scanners. Additionally, they offer specialized diagnostic and research instruments such as rapid test readers for lateral flow and biochemical assays, biological imaging systems, array imaging platforms, and SPR (Surface Plasmon Resonance) platforms. Established in 1993, Pacific Image Electronics is based in New Taipei City, Taiwan.
